description: This script automates building and running a Docker container that performs end-to-end testing of the 'openclaw' project, including custom systemctl and loginctl mock implementations, npm package management, and verification of service entry points.

methods.name: assert_entrypoint
methods.description: Verifies that the systemd unit file has the expected ExecStart entry point.

methods.name: run_flow
methods.description: Automates testing different installation and execution flows by installing services, running the doctor command, and verifying entry points.
